summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the shared venv Python. Choices: an explicit Node guard before graph lookups so None and strings raise SHACLPathError rather than acting as wildcards; three-item sequence and alternative expectations built with constructors because rdflib's operators nest binary paths. Not verified: mypy and black/isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore comments and formatting were checked by reading only. No commits made.
